title: Scorpio's feelings have a 9-digit PIN.
caption: Scorpio keeps every feeling behind nine locks and two alarms. You don't have to open the whole vault. This week, share one small thing, like your love of bad movies, and see who says me too. Send this to the Scorpio with the most locks.
